messages.author: b1c85aa4fa464db9
messages.subject: blogging workflow with RWordPress
parts:
Is RWordPress the package of choice for createing blog entries from R notebook data analysis and apps hosted on shinyapps.io?   

What is the recommended workflow for publishing a blog  entry (on Wordpress or other blogging sites),  from R notebook analysis and  shinyapps.io apps?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] blogging workflow with RWordPress
parts:
If you have to stick to WordPress, yes, I think RWordPress is probably
the only option if you want to publish blog posts from R.

For other blogging engines, I will probably start thinking and
tackling this general problem in one or two months.

For Shiny apps, you can just publish them to shinyapps.io and embed
them in R Markdown via knitr::include_app().

Regards,
Yihui
